001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
005import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
006import com.streamconverter.security.SecureXmlConfiguration;
007import java.io.IOException;
008import java.io.InputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.List;
012import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventFactory;
013import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
014import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
015import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLOutputFactory;
017import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
018import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
019import org.slf4j.Logger;
020import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
021
022/**
023 * XML Navigate Command Class
024 *
025 * <p>This class implements command for targeted XML transformation using XPath. It identifies
026 * specific elements using XPath expressions and applies IRule transformations to those elements
027 * while preserving the overall XML structure.
028 */
029public class XmlNavigateCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
030  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(XmlNavigateCommand.class);
031  private static final XMLEventFactory EVENT_FACTORY = XMLEventFactory.newInstance();
032
033  private TreePath treePath;
034  private IRule rule;
035
036  /**
037   * Constructor for XML navigation with TreePath selector and transformation rule.
038   *
039   * @param treePath the TreePath to select elements
040   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
041   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
042   */
043  private XmlNavigateCommand(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
044    this.treePath = treePath;
045    this.rule = rule;
046  }
047
048  /**
049   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command with TreePath and rule.
050   *
051   * @param treePath the TreePath to select elements
052   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
053   * @return an XmlNavigateCommand that transforms the specified TreePath elements with the given
054   *     rule
055   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
056   */
057  public static XmlNavigateCommand create(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
058    if (treePath == null) {
059      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
060    }
061    if (rule == null) {
062      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
063    }
064    return new XmlNavigateCommand(treePath, rule);
065  }
066
067  @Override
068  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
069    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
070    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
071
072    try {
073      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
074      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(outputStream);
075      navigateXmlWithRule(eventReader, eventWriter, treePath, rule);
076    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
077      handleXmlException(e);
078    } finally {
079      closeResources(eventReader, eventWriter);
080    }
081  }
082
083  private void navigateXmlWithRule(
084      XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter, TreePath treePath, IRule rule)
085      throws XMLStreamException {
086    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
087
088    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
089      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
090
091      if (event.isStartElement()) {
092        currentPath.add(event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart());
093      } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
094        currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
095      } else if (event.isCharacters() && treePath.matches(currentPath)) {
096        String transformed = rule.apply(event.asCharacters().getData());
097        event = EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters(transformed);
098      }
099
100      eventWriter.add(event);
101    }
102  }
103
104  // Common factory methods and utilities
105  private XMLEventReader createXMLEventReader(InputStream inputStream) throws XMLStreamException {
106    XMLInputFactory inputFactory = SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLInputFactory();
107    XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
108    if (!reader.hasNext()) {
109      throw new XMLStreamException("Empty XML input");
110    }
111    return reader;
112  }
113
114  private XMLEventWriter createXMLEventWriter(OutputStream outputStream) throws XMLStreamException {
115    XMLOutputFactory outputFactory = XMLOutputFactory.newInstance();
116    return outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(outputStream);
117  }
118
119  private void handleXmlException(XMLStreamException e) throws IOException {
120    String message = e.getMessage();
121    if (message != null && (message.contains("unclosed") || message.contains("end"))) {
122      throw new IOException("Invalid XML format - unclosed tags", e);
123    }
124    throw new IOException("Invalid XML format", e);
125  }
126
127  private void closeResources(XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter) {
128    if (eventWriter != null) {
129      try {
130        eventWriter.close();
131      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
132        LOGGER.warn("Failed to close XMLEventWriter", e);
133      }
134    }
135    if (eventReader != null) {
136      try {
137        eventReader.close();
138      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
139        LOGGER.warn("Failed to close XMLEventReader", e);
140      }
141    }
142  }
143}
